Round 64 acquired 40 USDA NRCS PLANTS distribution CSVs once, partitioned them deterministically across all 51 jurisdictions, completed 125,760 county-species outcomes, and moved 123,080 unique pairs across 50 jurisdictions: 11,931 to verified present and 111,149 to researched unresolved. releaseVerification.note: Build-time readiness and deployed-release evidence are separate. A committed artifact cannot attest to a future deployment of its own commit.
